description: This file defines the AggregatedCachePressureMonitor class, which manages a collection of cache pressure monitors, tracks their pressure status, and logs relevant messages. It implements the ICachePressureMonitor interface and extends List<ICachePressureMonitor>.

classes.name: AggregatedCachePressureMonitor
classes.description: A class that aggregates multiple cache pressure monitors, tracks their pressure status, and logs status changes.

methods.name: AggregatedCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor with a logger and optional cache monitor.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records cache pressure contribution across all monitors in the group.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a new cache pressure monitor to the group.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines if any monitor in the group is under pressure and logs status changes.
